_doc: Phase-0 reactor stand-in (SKILL.md §8, PRD FR-48, CRUCIBLE A23). Machine-readable twin of the SKILL.md §8 table: tests/test_routines.py fails when the two drift. Each routine is a Claude Code Routine that starts a fresh session in the marketing-engineer environment on its cron (UTC); the SessionStart hook (.claude/hooks/session-start.sh) installs Chromium, Python deps, and reads secrets from the host store. Registration itself is T13 step 7 (quiz decision 7, Sam 2026-09-04): one create_trigger per entry with create_new_session_on_fire=true; `scripts/routines.py register --print` prints the exact arguments and registers nothing. `scripts/routines.py dry-run <name>` runs a routine's steps locally against the dev warehouse; `steps[].script` null means the orchestrator says so and stops (SKILL.md §3). `steps[].connector` names the claude.ai connector the session uses after that step's script (Sam 2026-10-28: the check-in goes out through the Gmail connector: `scripts/checkin.py --send-pending` prints the send_message call, the session makes it, then `--mark-sent <key> --message-id <id>`; the Monday memo goes out the same way under `memo-<slug>-<UTC day>`); a routine's connectors are the union of its steps' and are the only connectors its trigger gets.

routines.name: me-morning
routines.prompt: Use the marketing-engineer skill. Run: status, pull insights, apply actions --reconcile, check-in for client upclicklabs, then send the pending check-in through the Gmail connector and mark it sent. Do not propose a new batch. End with the runs summary.

steps.say: send the pending check-in through the Gmail connector and mark it sent

routines.name: me-evening
routines.prompt: Use the marketing-engineer skill. Run: status, pull insights for client upclicklabs. If capacity has freed (in-flight sub-sample creatives < capacity − batch_size), run plan batch and stop for Sam's picks. End with the runs summary.

steps.say: plan batch (only when capacity has freed; the planner enforces FR-16 itself)

routines.name: me-monday
routines.prompt: Use the marketing-engineer skill. Run: status, monday memo for client upclicklabs, then send the pending memo through the Gmail connector and mark it sent. Then stop.

steps.say: send the pending memo through the Gmail connector and mark it sent
